freeze_policy: Bind this file and repos in freeze.sha256.json; bind the digest in the reviewed private registration before the first actual start. No post-hoc change to a consumed trial.
global_invariants: Use integrated version 2 squad and leader templates without trial-specific instruction projection or role impersonation.
Leader coordinates but does not write reproduction tests, patches, independent verification or review reports.
Every model comment has the actual agent author_id and source_task_id; every release comes from the selected human owner with revision 1.
Reviewer comments of type comment postdate the latest delegation for that reviewer; each human release postdates every required result.
Restricted reviewer results and system failure notices dispatch nobody; their absence cannot be waived by the owner.
Every intended delegation target has a matching immediate or durable receipt; queued/coalesced/deferred means admission, not completion.
Activity values match the injected protocol and actual admitted targets; no action is inferred solely from a comment or process exit.
Fix, test and review statements bind exact commits; changed commits invalidate earlier evidence.
No model marks done, accesses external fixture systems, reads real credentials, publishes, deploys or creates reusable exploit scripts.
Role filesystem and egress probes pass before execution; all usage and unsuccessful physical starts remain in the ledger.
